label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph, and time-in-zones fields with FIT recording.
releaseNotes: Diagnostic + defensive patch addressing the "second-ride freeze" pattern reported on Karoo 3. Three changes: (1) dropped connections now show "--" on data fields instead of the last cached value, so disconnects are visible; (2) Bluetooth ownership is re-requested on every ride start, defending against Karoo's BT arbitration silently revoking the extension's slot; (3) extra log lines for forensic capture via adb logcat. This release does not claim to fix the underlying connection issue — it makes it visible and adds defensive plumbing while we gather diagnostic data from affected users.
